page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.re6.52xlarge is a memory-optimized instance built on x86_64 architecture and managed via the KVM hypervisor. The host utilizes 208 dedicated vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 8269CL processors. It provides 3072 GB of system memory, which yields an allocation ratio of 14.77 GB of RAM per vCPU. Baseline network performance for this instance is rated at 32 Gbps.

The instance does not include local NVMe or SSD storage devices, nor does it contain discrete GPU accelerators. Data persistence must be established via network-attached storage connected over the 32 Gbps network interface. The primary structural characteristic of the hardware configuration is its high memory-to-compute ratio.

From a hardware consolidation perspective, ecs.re6.52xlarge offers high memory capacity within a single virtual instance. This allows large datasets to fit entirely within system RAM without requiring multi-node clustering. Practical workload applications include in-memory relational and non-relational databases, real-time analytics platforms, enterprise resource planning deployments, and large caching layers.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.re6.52xlarge is a memory-optimized cloud server powered by Intel Xeon 8269CL processors on x86_64 architecture with KVM virtualization. It features 208 dedicated vCPUs and 3072 GB of RAM, yielding a high resource ratio of 14.77 GB of memory per core. The server includes a 32 Gbps baseline network bandwidth allocation. It lacks local ephemeral storage and onboard GPU accelerators, necessitating network-attached storage for persistent operational data. The high memory density provides resource efficiency by consolidating massive datasets into a single instance footprint, avoiding multi-node cluster overhead. Target workloads include large-scale in-memory databases, real-time data processing engines, high-capacity distributed caching, and enterprise applications requiring extensive system memory.
